name: deep-research
description: Task-driven web research with evidence-first search, reading, synthesis, and competition postmortem discovery.

interface.longDescription: Turn a research task into evidence needs, search and read primary sources, and synthesize grounded conclusions. Competition research prioritizes participant postmortems, decisions, failures, and transferable lessons over leaderboard scores alone.
defaultPrompt: Research this task and synthesize the strongest evidence.
Find participant postmortems and lessons from this competition.
